q: How do I work out electricity carbon per carat for an HPHT diamond press?
title: HPHT diamond press: carbon per carat
short: Meter each press, add the kWh for every growth run in a month, multiply by your grid factor and divide by rough carats grown. HPHT presses run hot and long, so electricity dominates; use metered runs, not nameplate ratings.
audience: Lab grown diamond growers using HPHT cubic presses in Surat and elsewhere in Gujarat

ol: kWh per press per month from sub meters.
Multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, or by the factor for your supply if you buy green power with valid attributes.
Divide by rough carats grown, then by the cutting yield if a buyer wants per polished carat.

p: Using press rating times hours overstates use when presses cycle; ignoring chillers and compressors understates it. Meter the plant auxiliaries and share them by run hours.
A low carbon claim needs the electricity contract and meter data behind it. Without them, the grid factor applies.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
